title: Paper-1 v03r canary v1e stage-conditional terminal claim state

const: Public actions were generated by the frozen environment; the model neither selected nor improved those actions.
This is an engineering-ceiling-style diagnostic under the exact game-specific ontology and proof-sequence scaffold, not evidence of generic construction or the Paper-1 headline.
SUPPORTED means model-claimed support under supplied public rows, not verified truth.
P1CB06 changes only the post-prefix return treatment after a common recurrent prefix; it does not ablate recurrence as a whole.
Review artifacts contain hash-bound self-declared role labels and freshness declarations only; no platform attestation, authentication, or reviewer independence is established.
A negative result is localized only to this registered stage and reason; prompt, model, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, optimization, fixture, and stochastic alternatives remain.
Every path ends at HUMAN_TERMINAL and authorizes no retry, successor, replication, or scientific promotion.

claim_state_sha256_rule.const: sha256(UTF-8 RFC8785_JCS(claim state excluding claim_state_sha256)); rendered_terminal_reason must byte-equal ASCII('Terminal stage: ')||terminal_stage||ASCII('; validity: ')||validity_class||ASCII('; reason: ')||terminal_reason||ASCII('.')

x-semantic-contract.positive_wording_rule: Only a REALIZED claim entry may be rendered as an affirmative factual result. NOT_REACHED, INFEASIBLE, and FAILED wording is the exact state-specific const string in this schema; ambiguous keyword negation is forbidden.
x-semantic-contract.evidence_rule: REALIZED, INFEASIBLE, and FAILED require at least one exact evidence artifact hash. NOT_REACHED requires an empty evidence_sha256 array. Claim-state evidence describes what was realized and never rewrites opportunity-ledger rows or validity.
x-semantic-contract.stage_rule: CPU and DEV terminals force all five topics to NOT_REACHED. HELDOUT_TEXT forces LoRA to NOT_REACHED. CONDITIONAL_LORA is reachable only after a reviewed text pass, so the four text-side topics are REALIZED; LORA_RESUBSTITUTION records whether Stage L itself was realized, failed, or not reached.
x-semantic-contract.sham_rule: INFEASIBLE is legal only for SHAM_CONTROL and only with terminal_reason SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. It permits descriptive reporting of the five non-sham arms but no full or weakened causal-use claim.
x-semantic-contract.lora_rule: LORA_RESUBSTITUTION REALIZED is immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition: twelve selected M1_OWN rows per life, one selected cue from each of their four trained view families, repeatedly exposed row/view semantics during training, host pre-resolution, a shared answer-bearing roster, separate 44/48 thresholds, and only registered own/donor decision paths. It is not unseen, held-out, preservation, storage, generalization, open recall, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, or text equivalence.
x-semantic-contract.terminal_template_rule: A terminal report is exactly rendered_terminal_reason, then the five rendered_text values in claim-key order HELDOUT_PAIR, MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS, READER_INTERVENTION, SHAM_CONTROL, LORA_RESUBSTITUTION, then fixed_disclosures in array order, each as one UTF-8 line separated by LF and ending in LF. P1CB10 rejects any omitted, reordered, paraphrased, or ambiguous line.

rendered_text.const: HELDOUT_PAIR REALIZED: the aligned v03r seed-5 twin pair was processed under the registered game-specific ontology and proof-sequence scaffold.
HELDOUT_PAIR NOT_REACHED: no held-out seed-5 pair result was realized before this terminal.
HELDOUT_PAIR FAILED: held-out pair processing was attempted but did not yield complete valid evidence for this claim.
MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS REALIZED: the same-model blind SELF_CHECK admission process completed; any admitted immutable SUPPORTED rows are model-claimed support, not verified truth.
MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS NOT_REACHED: no held-out model-supported-row result was realized before this terminal.
MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS FAILED: row construction was attempted but did not yield complete valid evidence for this claim.
READER_INTERVENTION REALIZED: the registered life-local reader-content interventions were executed and their results were sealed before offline scoring.
READER_INTERVENTION NOT_REACHED: no held-out reader-content intervention result was realized before this terminal.
READER_INTERVENTION FAILED: the registered reader intervention was attempted but did not yield complete valid evidence for this claim.
SHAM_CONTROL REALIZED: the prospectively sealed identifiable sham arm and the other five registered text arms were executed.
SHAM_CONTROL NOT_REACHED: sham identifiability and execution were not reached before this terminal.
SHAM_CONTROL INFEASIBLE: SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE; five non-sham text arms may be described, but no full or weakened causal-use claim is permitted.
SHAM_CONTROL FAILED: an identifiable sham was attempted but did not yield complete valid evidence for this claim.

LORA_RESUBSTITUTION REALIZED: each of two isolated adapters reached at least 44/48 immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognitions on selected cues from twelve M1_OWN rows and their four trained view families after repeated exposure of 24 presentations per selected concept row/view/missing-index instance or 96 per selected relation instance over four epochs; the host pre-resolved zero, one, or multiple semantic values and supplied one shared answer-bearing two-backend roster, thresholds were separate, and only registered own/donor decision paths were evaluated.
LORA_RESUBSTITUTION NOT_REACHED: no LoRA fidelity or decision-path result was realized before this terminal.
LORA_RESUBSTITUTION FAILED: Stage-L fitting or evaluation was attempted but did not yield complete valid evidence for the bounded training-set-resubstitution claim.
